narrative:
They say the best things take time, and our 15-year story is proof. From meeting through mutual friends at a part-time job to navigating college and four years of long distance across the miles, we’ve spent a lifetime growing up together.

After officially tying the knot in a civil wedding back in 2022, we are so ready to bring our journey full circle. We are thrilled to finally gather our families together for the garden wedding we’ve always dreamed of—celebrating the beautiful history we share and the many chapters still to come.
